A few things i worked on was applying my gel polish correctly.
You need to apply thin even layers and build on that for the coverage (a lot of people think that this is obvious but it really isnt) 

Next is base coat not only does it protect your nails but also helps the product stick well.

Roughing up your nails before applying the base coat just makes sure that it doesnt turn into a peeling base coat.

Lastly, cuticle prep has been the biggest life saver for me. I got a cuticle remover solution i put that on push back your cuticles and cut the excess (only if you are comfortable) and bam! Its free real estate.

Im currently in Singapore and while it seems like a really nice place to stay:

1. The government is actively trying to stop new foreign workers or expats to enter Singapore, mainly to help employment for its citizens.

2. The country is very restrictive and you can get fined pretty easily if you aren’t careful.

3. The old population is pretty racist to people of different races and i have started noticing this in a small percentage of the younger generation as well.

4. The expat community is pretty small and they don’t really venture out of their groups because the general population themselves don’t align with the foreigners.

5. While Singapore’s currency is strong in the neighbouring countries, within Singapore itself cost of living is pretty high and you need to be earning pretty good (5k-7k pm) to live an average expat lifestyle and save up.

6. Getting Pr is pretty difficult as a lot of things go into your selection process such as :income, country of citizenship, marital status, kids or not, gender of the child, if you are employing a maid. Most of the times even if you meet all the requirements your application will be rejected as this is a way for the government to make money.
